stem: A technician discovers after the crop walk that a photo was linked to the wrong plant ID. Which correction best preserves record integrity?
choices: Create a new entry with the correct plant ID and remove the incorrect link so only the corrected state remains visible
Leave the original record unchanged and tell the next shift verbally which plant the image actually shows
Add a free-text note with the correct plant ID but do not connect the note to the original image record
Use the controlled correction method so the original association, corrected plant identity, correction time and correction history remain reconstructable
rationale: A correction should fix the identity error without erasing or disconnecting the original history. The controlled correction preserves what was originally recorded, what changed, and the corrected state so another reviewer can reconstruct the sequence.
